Chapter 1 — Thin Air

The barometer dropped three millibars before dusk, and frost already traced the brass telescope mount. We lit the kerosene lamp in the study, recorded the wind velocity, and waited for the ridge clouds to scatter.

By midnight the sky cleared completely, revealing Orion high above the eastern crest. Every lens held steady, and the faint hum of the clock drive filled the dome with a patient rhythm.
